d sisive.bio: Toronto rapper D-Sisive, born Derek Christoff, is known for introspective, autobiographical hip-hop that helped establish him as one of Canada's most acclaimed underground MCs.

dj shub.bio: Mohawk producer and turntablist Shub, formerly known as DJ Shub, is a Six Nations artist and former A Tribe Called Red member who helped pioneer the powwow-step sound.

dl incognito.bio: Ottawa rapper and producer DL Incognito, born Oliver Nestor, is a veteran of Canadian underground hip-hop whose independent catalogue earned multiple Juno nominations.

dominique fils-aimé.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Dominique Fils-Aimé blends vocal jazz, soul and blues in a body of work rooted in Black musical history, expressive harmony and immersive live performance.
